thread:
elaine: Quick thread to finalize hero copy + CTA routing for Hosted / Dedicated / Private ahead of launch. Need final lines and exact form routing.

ana: I'll keep them outcome-first and short (<=7 words). Drafts:
Hosted: "Ship fast, scale confidently"
Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, dependable latency"
Private: "On-prem control with enterprise guardrails"

mike: Solid. Swap Private to mention compliance without making cert claims. Jamal to confirm legal wording.

jamal: Confirming: use "designed for compliance" not "certified" unless legal signs off.

elaine: CTA verbs: Hosted primary: "Start free trial" secondary: "Watch launch webinar". Dedicated primary: "Request capacity demo". Private primary: "Schedule private demo". All pages keep a webinar secondary CTA.

luis: Routing plan and hidden inputs (implementation):
<form>
  <input type="hidden" name="lead_path" value="selfserve|enterprise|webinar">
  <input type="hidden" name="source_page" value="hosted|dedicated|private">
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="tri_mode_launch_2023">
</form>
Override: if "Talk to sales" checked, set lead_path=enterprise and lead_owner=SDR.
GTM events: tri_mode_cta_click (label=page), tri_mode_form_submit (label=lead_path). I'll drop tag names in /product-analytics.

mike: Mapping: Hosted -> selfserve (product), Dedicated -> enterprise (SDR), Private -> enterprise (SDR). Webinar signups -> nurture list. Include source_page always for segmentation.

ana: For the webinar CTA copy be contextual: Hosted: "Watch: quickstart + cost tips"; Dedicated: "Watch: throughput & scaling patterns"; Private: "Watch: security & deployment checklist".

design-bot: Reminder: hero images + copy must be locked for QA by 18:00 UTC.

elaine: Webinar structure: 25-min product/demo, 10-min benchmarks & methodology (call out dataset, avg seq length, model family; include "results vary by model & workload"), 25-min customer stories + Q&A.

jamal: Legal flag: Private page must avoid implying certifications. I'll sign off final wording if Ana uses "designed for compliance".

luis: I'll implement hidden fields and GTM events today, will add lead_owner and lead_timestamp on submit for sequencing. Also will add `lead_source=web` and `lead_id` UUID.

mike: Marketing deliverables: Ana final copy by EOD, Luis tracking by 5pm, Design lock by 17:00 PT, Launch post draft by tomorrow 09:00.

deploy-bot: Content freeze reminder: 2023-11-15T18:00:00Z.

elaine: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as canonical for hero copy + routing rules. Ping here with any last tweaks.
